title: irlpls Policy 2026-10-26
description: Rules a requester sets once; the broker executes them. Evaluated only against what Capture Cards state: an unknown right or unproven guarantee is a violation, never a pass. A violating order is never sent.

max_order_usd.description: Ceiling on a commission's quoted total

free_only.description: Only providers whose Capture Card says they are free to use

auto_submit.description: Standing mandate: the broker may confirm orders within max_order_usd without asking. Has no effect unless max_order_usd is set.

require_c2pa.description: The camera guarantee must be backed by C2PA (standard: c2pa)

min_assurance_level.description: ...from a C2PA conforming product at this assurance level or higher

allow_person_targeting.description: A request that watches, follows or photographs a specific person may go to people-based providers. Off by default.
